rationale.edition: All 38 changed files live under web/src/ (components/ and composables/) — the open-source Vue 3 frontend. No path touches an enterprise-owned directory (no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/), and no enterprise keyword modules (SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/cipher/logo-management) appear in the changed paths or symbol names, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The trigger context has no tests-added label and no skip comment. The change is a substantial refactor of the user-facing AI Assistant chat panel (O2AIChat.vue split into sub-components and composables) — it is frontend UI behavior, not docs/CI-only or comment/test-data-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The refactor rewrites the rendering and interaction of chat messages, tool-call blocks, the chat history menu, and the input control in web/src — user-facing flows (streaming, markdown rendering, keyboard navigation, session/history management) that could regress. The dev-authored .spec.ts files are Vitest unit tests, not Playwright E2E, so there is no browser-level coverage of the new structure.
rationale.area: The bulk of the UI changes live in web/src/components/ai-assistant/chat/ and web/src/composables/ — a general, app-wide AI assistant feature not tied to Logs/Metrics/Traces/Dashboards. The closest existing test area is GeneralTests (which holds general app-level specs such as sanity, theme, landingPage, and languageTranslation).
rationale.group: GeneralTests is the matrix shard (actual_folder GeneralTests) whose run_files hold general app-level specs, so the new aiAssistantChat.spec.js joins it. No dedicated AI-assistant shard exists in ci_matrix; the Engineer may create one if a dedicated group is preferred.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The only test files changed are Vitest unit specs under web/src/components/**/*.spec.ts and web/src/composables/*.spec.ts, which are not E2E coverage, so existing_tests_in_diff is false.
